# Maestros Services

> Owner-operated residential landscaping on Vancouver Island, BC. Practical lawn care, exterior cleanup, power washing, driveway work, fence repairs, and related property maintenance for homeowners across lower-mid Vancouver Island.

Maestros Services is based in Shawnigan Lake, BC, and serves residential properties throughout Greater Victoria and the Cowichan Valley.

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 8:00–18:00
- Saturday: 9:00–16:00
- Sunday: closed

## Contact

- Phone: 250-858-1781
- Email: quotes@maestrosservices.com

## Services

- Lawn Mowing and Clean Edging
- Hedge, Shrub, and Small Tree Trimming
- Mulching and Garden Bed Refresh
- Seasonal Cleanups (Spring and Fall)
- Weed Control and Tidy-Ups
- Yard Waste Haul-Away
- Small Brush Clearing
- Ground-Accessible Gutter Cleaning
- Light Pruning and Shape-Ups
- Surface Moss and Algae Treatment
- Fence Work and Minor Repairs
- Power Washing for Driveways, Patios, and Exteriors
- Rock Work and Garden Wall Builds
- Driveway Grading and Re-Leveling
- Gravel Driveway Installation and Refresh

## Service areas

Greater Victoria: Victoria, Saanich, Central Saanich, North Saanich, Brentwood Bay, Sidney, Langford, Colwood, View Royal, Esquimalt, Sooke, Metchosin, Highlands

Cowichan Valley: Shawnigan Lake, Mill Bay, Cobble Hill, Cowichan Bay, Chemainus, Maple Bay, Lake Cowichan, Duncan
